name: Paul Denniston
reason: Grief-led throughout: his work is Grief Yoga, and every paid course (Moving into Empowerment, Elevate chair course, Transform for breakup, divorce and betrayal), the Spark membership, the Grief Movement Training for therapists and his book Healing Through Yoga are sold on releasing the pain of grief, loss and trauma, with groups for cancer, suicide loss, Alzheimer's and addiction; his free classes and YouTube appearances are framed the same way ("How Grief Yoga Can Heal: And Where Trauma Lives in the Body"). Under the strict health rule (grief therapy counts as condition framing) only the six-week Wonderland series (11 Nov to 16 Dec 2026) stands on its own, which is too little for a page. His Commune classes are membership-only. Also queued as rank 129 in Insight Timer sprint 2 (he is in insight-timer-faculty.json, 335 followers); the same reason applies there. A published email exists (paul@griefyoga.com, griefyoga.com/contact) if the owner wants to reconsider.
